newsitem.title: USA: Everything Santa Claus needs to know.
newsitem.headline: Everything Santa Claus needs to know.

text.p: Relax Santa -- the average toddler wants off your lap after only 45 seconds.
A quarterly magazine called "Year 'Round Christmas" served up that fact on Thursday, based on information from a Santa Claus training school.
It also found that the most popular request department store and mall-sitting Santas get is for a baby sister or a baby brother.
And it revealed the most common boo-boo committed by Santas-for-hire is not using a reliable deodorant or mouthwash.
The magazine is based in Downers Grove, Illinois.
